verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The photo is cropped to half a face, with one eye, and the blue panel covers most of the model. The thin outline frame floats loose over the foliage instead of framing the panel. '14' is split away from 'August', and 'FREE JOIN' wraps onto two lines. A spreads the panel content more evenly. B pushes 'August' up against the panel's top edge and leaves a large empty block of blue at the bottom.
